t: Lubricates to prevent rust and corrosion. Fast-acting solution that quickly penetrates its way into hard to reach areas, rapidly loosening seized fixings, stuck or rusted moving parts. Use on metal, alloys, rubber, plastic and most paints. Highly water-resistant. Withstands temperatures of -20° to 90°C. Releases items that are locked or rusted. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows for upright or upside-down application.
